targets.Name: install-hooks
targets.Description: Install Gollemer Git pre-commit validation hook

targets.Name: train
targets.Description: Start a fresh curriculum training (clears MoE models, preserves word2vec)

targets.Name: train-resume
targets.Description: Start training without cleaning existing model checkpoints

targets.Name: train-fresh
targets.Description: Full fresh start — clears ALL models including word2vec, then trains

targets.Name: train-small
targets.Description: Run the small social dataset, print loss + memory, and test the model

targets.Name: train-small-seq2seq
targets.Description: Run a strict pure Q->A seq2seq tiny demo

targets.Name: test-small-seq2seq
targets.Description: Load the tiny seq2seq model and probe a few prompts

targets.Name: seq2seq-prompt
targets.Description: Send a custom prompt to the saved tiny seq2seq model

targets.Name: seq2seq-chat
targets.Description: Start an interactive tiny seq2seq chat loop with the saved model

targets.Name: chat
targets.Description: Start an interactive full MoE chat loop with conversation history

targets.Name: metrics
targets.Description: Run metrics aggregation and CSV export for edit logs

targets.Name: export-labels
targets.Description: Export training examples to CSV for manual labeling
targets.Command:
@echo " Exporting edits_failed.jsonl -> data/training/edits_for_labeling.csv"
@go run scripts/export_for_labeling.go || true

targets.Name: clean
targets.Description: Remove MoE model checkpoints (preserves word2vec)
targets.Command:
rm -f data/models/gob_models/*.gob
@if [ -f data/models/gob_models/word2vec_model.gob.bak ]; then \
cp data/models/gob_models/word2vec_model.gob.bak data/models/gob_models/word2vec_model.gob 2>/dev/null || true; \
fi

targets.Name: clean-all
targets.Description: Remove ALL model files including word2vec

targets.Name: conversing-pb
targets.Description: Convert conversing.yaml to conversing.pb

targets.Name: social-replies-pb
targets.Description: Convert social_replies.yaml to social_replies.pb

targets.Name: tech-multiturn-pb
targets.Description: Convert tech_multiturn.yaml to tech_multiturn.pb

targets.Name: all-pb
targets.Description: Convert all YAML training files to protobuf

targets.Name: makefile-pb
targets.Description: Convert Makefile targets to protobuf training data

targets.Name: makefile-train
targets.Description: Train on social + makefile-generated data only

targets.Name: chat-makefile
targets.Description: Start makefile chat with top command predictions

targets.Name: sel
targets.Description: Interactive fuzzy finder target selector
targets.Command:
$$1=$$2=""; \
printf "%-22s %s\n", cmd, $$0; \
}' $(MAKEFILE_LIST) | go run ./cmd/tools/goz/main.go -h 25); \
if [ -n "$$target" ]; then \
$(MAKE) $$target; \
fi
